scenario.summary: SafePay ransomware actors gain initial access through credential harvesting, brute-force attacks, and exploitation of vulnerabilities in VPN and edge devices like Cisco and Veeam. Once inside, they escalate privileges via UAC bypass, move laterally using RDP and PsExec, and utilize RMM tools for persistence before exfiltrating data and deploying encryption.

hunt.name: SafePay: Internal Discovery and Lateral Movement
hunt.description: This hunt focuses on the middle phase of a SafePay ransomware intrusion. SafePay actors use living-off-the-land binaries (LOLBins) like PsExec and WinRM alongside legitimate RMM tools such as AnyDesk and ScreenConnect to pivot through the network. They concurrently use PowerShell scripts like ShareFinder to identify valuable assets and modify Windows Defender settings to avoid detection. The hunt identifies the execution of these tools, correlates them with suspicious script content, and examines network traffic to remote management ports.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, parent_process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{discovery_tools}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{discovery_tools}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_original_file_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_name, process_path, parent_process_name, process_cmd_line, device_hostname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) <= 3
config.description: Find the execution of tools SafePay uses for lateral movement and host enumeration, filtering for rare occurrences.
config.expected_signal: Rows show legitimate tools running in unusual contexts, such as from user profiles or by unauthorized users, limited to rare sightings across the fleet.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, script_name, script_content, actor_user_name, time FROM hb_script_activity WHERE (LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%sharefinder%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%get-netshare%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%invoke-sharefinder%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%netshareenum%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%get-adcomputer%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%ldap://%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Locate PowerShell activity targeting network shares or performing Active Directory enumeration to identify valuable assets.
config.expected_signal: Script blocks containing ShareFinder functions or AD query commands. Silence suggests no such scripts were executed within the window.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_port, COUNT(*) AS connections, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE (dst_endpoint_port IN (3389, 5985, 5986) OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%anydesk%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%teamviewer%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_port HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) <= 3
config.description: Stack-count network connections to remote management ports used for lateral movement.
config.expected_signal: A small number of hosts connecting to RDP or WinRM ports, or using RMM software. Rare connections stand out from normal administrative baseline.
